input_schema.component_id: string | The canonical component id namespace for the cache key.
input_schema.key: string | The cache key within the component namespace.
input_schema.value: object | The JSON-serializable value to persist.
input_schema.ttl_seconds: integer | optional | null | Optional TTL override in seconds; null uses the service default.

output_schema.component_id: string | The canonical component id namespace for the cache key.
output_schema.key: string | The cache key within the component namespace.
output_schema.value: object | The JSON value that was persisted.
output_schema.ttl_seconds: integer | null | The effective TTL applied to the key; null means the key does not expire.
